name: Silvia Perez
source:
Female Doll engineer and swindler. Wakaba and company met her in White capital.

[spoiler]Silvia was born in a rich family and was quite a spoiled child. But than the Sister which she was friends with broken, Silvia changed and decided to became a Doll engineer.

She is in love with Tonino but can't confess to him honestly because of her personality.[/spoiler]
